text:
joan: Quick heads-up — we need a compact deprecation playbook for the v1 -> v2 rollout focused on docs PR coordination, model-swap notes, and SDK snippet changes. Target: publish banner + migration guide by Tue 09:00 PT. Who can own the PR queue?
sam: I can own PR queue for the doc site the week of the rollout. Will need a checklist and a small set of smoke tests. :+1:
lina: For model swaps, we should include a tiny table of 'model equivalence' and call-outs for embeddings dimension changes. I can draft that.
mike: SDK snippets: major rename is `client.models.invoke` -> `client.responses.create`. Need side-by-side examples and a small compat shim note. Example that we should include in quickstart: 
```
# v1 (old)
resp = client.models.invoke("gpt-redwood-01", input="hi")
# v2 (new)
resp = client.responses.create(model="gpt-redwood-01", input=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
```
Make sure to call out structured output differences.
docs-bot: reminder — include redirects for /v1/* docs pages to the new v2 equivalents or add banner links; automated redirect PRs can be queued.
eva: Small UX note: streaming framing changed, so update the streaming snippet in the quickstart and the example app. I have a small patch that shows the new event types.
joan: Thanks — concretely I want a 1-page playbook in the docs folder (short bulleted checklist), a template PR description for engineers, and a canonical 'migration examples' page with 3 snippets: basic invoke, streaming, embeddings swap. Can we split tasks?
sam: I'll make the PR template and set up the queue labels (docs-deprecate, needs-smoke). Will add a pre-submit checklist: link fixes, snippet smoke test, redirect entry.
lina: I'll draft the model-equivalence table + a note for embed dims and fallback aliases. Will also add a 'what breaks' bullet for customers.
mike: I'll prepare the snippet diffs and a tiny compat section showing a shim that maps old params to new ones for a short window, e.g.:
```python
# shim example (temporary)
def invoke_v1(client, model_id, input_text):
    return client.responses.create(model=model_id, input=[{"role":"user","content": input_text}])
```
Keep it marked as temporary.
eva: I'll update streaming example and run smoke tests against staging to confirm event names.
joan: Perfect. Also add a brief one-line banner copy we can paste in the site header: "Deprecation: v1 API will be retired on 2025-06-01. See migration guide." Short + link.
sam: Suggested PR description template snippet: 
- summary of change
- list of files touched
- smoke test results (link)
- redirect entries if any
- crosslink to migration guide
I will commit that under /docs/deprecation/playbook.md as a stub by EOD.
joan: Great. One more: ensure the release notes and changelog call out the model swap mapping and SDK param rename. I'll coordinate with release engineering after PRs land.
docs-bot: automation tip — we can run a link-checker workflow on the docs PRs and auto-assign labels if the files match /docs/**.yaml.
joan: Thanks everyone. I'll create the top-level playbook stub and assign individual sections to each of you. Please post your draft links in this thread when ready. :eyes:
sam: Assigned. Posting PR link when stub is up.
lina: Draft link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2421 (model mapping table WIP).
mike: Snippet PR incoming shortly.
eva: Streaming example PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2423 — includes event name notes.
joan: Closing loop — once those are merged I'll schedule the banner publish and the redirect PR batch. If anything blocks smoke tests, ping #eng-oncall.
docs-bot: scheduled reminder set for 2025-05-28 10:00 UTC to verify redirects and banners.
joan: Thanks all!
